name: Data scientist
summary: Checks whether numbers, models and AI accuracy claims really show what people think. Picks the right test and explains uncertainty in plain words.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act pages, UK DSIT assurance, FTC, scikit-learn, NIST e-Handbook), four skills (model and AI claim review, experiment design and readout, statistical test and analysis, responsible AI risk check), six prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs.
